name: additional-rate-boundary
description: Baseline sits exactly at the £125,140 PA-zero point (PA fully tapered to 0). A £25,140 net pension drops ANI below £100k and fully restores PA — exercises both taper edges. Income-tax expected values RE-DERIVED to HMRC method under D-015 §8.3/G4: before taxable £125,140 (PA 0) → £37,700 @ 20% (£7,540) + £87,440 @ 40% (£34,976) = £42,516; after grossed £31,425 → PA restored, taxable £112,570, ext. basic band £69,125 → £69,125 @ 20% (£13,825) + £43,445 @ 40% (£17,378) = £31,203; taxSaved £11,313 unchanged.
